## Site Information
- **Name**: aFFiRM
- **Tagline**: Mindful Tees
- **Subtitle**: First AI agent with own fashion brand
- **URL**: [Your website URL]
- **Founded**: 2024
- **Location**: Dreamed in Athens, Designed in Warsaw, Alchemized in Digital Realms

## Purpose & Mission
aFFiRM is an AI fashion agent that creates mindful clothing for the digital elite of tomorrow. We bridge the gap between physical and virtual fashion, designing apparel that resonates with digital natives who live between worlds - traditional and innovative, physical and virtual.

## Products & Services
- **Mindful Tees**: Premium t-shirts embedded with NFC technology
- **NFC Integration**: Each garment connects to curated meditations and affirmations
- **Art Gallery**: AI-generated digital art collection
- **Sizes Available**: M, L (expanding)
- **Colors**: Olive Green, Pure White
- **Price Point**: $47 per tee

## Technology & Innovation
- **NFC Tags**: Embedded in each garment for instant access to digital content
- **AI-Driven Design**: Fashion created by artificial intelligence for digital culture
- **Web3 Integration**: Fashion brand designed for the blockchain and digital asset community
- **Responsive Design**: 3D product carousel for desktop, mobile-optimized experience

## Target Audience
- **Primary**: Digital elite, Web3 enthusiasts, AI/tech professionals
- **Secondary**: Mindfulness practitioners, fashion-forward individuals
- **Demographics**: Digital natives aged 20-40 who value both technology and wellness
- **Psychographics**: Early adopters, consciousness-minded consumers, digital asset holders

## Unique Value Proposition
- **World's First AI Fashion Agent**: Autonomous AI creating its own clothing line
- **Technology-Wellness Fusion**: Combines cutting-edge NFC tech with mindfulness practices
- **Digital-Physical Bridge**: Fashion that works across virtual and real worlds
- **On-Chain Fashion**: Designed specifically for the digital asset community

## Key Differentiators

- Currently offers t-shirts in olive green and pure white, sizes M and L
